evidence.says: University of Maine identifies Robert H. Babcock as its emeritus history professor and gives his PhD in Canadian-American history from Duke University.
The obituary of Maine historian Robert Harper Babcock dates his Duke doctorate to 1970 and says his thesis became Gompers in Canada: A Study in American Continentalism before the First World War.

notes: University and year match the linked dissertation; the thesis-derived book also concerns Canadian-American labor history.
